scenes.conflict: Tobias fears that speaking out will destroy the Guild's neutrality and standing, and urges caution while the Wardens pressure the Guild to withhold its data.
scenes.goal: Wren wants Guildmaster Tobias to publish her re-survey showing the skybridge decay follows a pattern and is accelerating.
scenes.outcome: Tobias privately confirms the maps are credible but refuses a public release; he agrees only to let Wren carry them to the enclaves on her own authority, without the Guild's backing.
scenes.summary: In the lantern-lit Guild hall, Wren lays out charts showing which anchors are dimming and in what order. Tobias recognises the disaster they foretell but holds back, sending Wren off with a quiet, deniable blessing.
scenes.title: The Pattern Revealed

scenes.conflict: The Accord is widely ignored, and no enclave delegate answers the summons; Tobias's caution clashes with Wren's urgency as another strand fades overhead.
scenes.goal: Wren and Tobias try to use unwritten Lantern Accord custom to force the enclaves to hear the maps.
scenes.outcome: The hearing fails to draw the other enclaves, but a minor span fades in view of the city, proving Wren's prediction and convincing her she must cross the archipelago in person.
scenes.summary: Wren invokes Accord custom through Tobias's knowledge of the law. The empty benches show how far the Accord has fallen, and the fading span makes the danger real.
scenes.title: The Accord Hearing

scenes.conflict: The Guild's vow of neutrality that raised her pulls against her need to take sides, and leaving without its sanction means breaking from the only home she knows.
scenes.goal: Wren prepares to leave Lantern Reach with her charts and a plan to persuade each enclave in turn.
scenes.outcome: Wren chooses to break neutrality and departs by wind-glider with her satchel of charts, resolving to begin at Ironroot Hold where the anchors are forged.
scenes.summary: Alone at the Guild's launch terrace, Wren weighs her vow against the fading strand and takes flight toward Ironroot Hold.
scenes.title: Leaving the Reach

scenes.conflict: Garrick dismisses the maps as a child's drawings because admitting they are right would undermine his Tribute Edict, and he demands tribute for any repair.
scenes.goal: Wren wants Warden-Chief Garrick to open anchor repair to a joint effort based on her decay maps.
scenes.outcome: Garrick bars Wren from the anchors and orders her out of the Hold, though his private flicker of doubt is visible to her.
scenes.summary: In the root-hung forges, Wren presents her charts to Garrick. He rejects them with scorn and closes the Hold to her.
scenes.title: Barred at Ironroot

scenes.conflict: Kest distrusts authority and the old enclaves, and agrees to guide her only for payment, sabotaging early offers of trust while Wardens hunt his routes.
scenes.goal: Wren seeks a guide who knows hidden glider routes to cross the gulfs between enclaves.
scenes.outcome: Kest agrees to guide Wren for a fee, planning to use the arrangement as leverage for the Hollow Drift, and Wren sees the shattered span that proves her maps' human cost.
scenes.summary: Among the broken arches of the Hollow Drift, Wren meets Kest, a wiry smuggler who lost his home to the Hollow Span's fall. A tense bargain is struck.
scenes.title: A Courier for Hire

scenes.conflict: Garrick's patrols hunt Kest's smuggling routes and now Wren, and Kest's reckless instincts clash with Wren's careful planning.
scenes.goal: Wren and Kest try to slip out of the Hollow Drift before Wardens enforcing the tribute catch them.
scenes.outcome: They escape by glider, but Wren's satchel is damaged and Kest, having shared real danger with her, begins to trust her.
scenes.summary: Garrick's Wardens close on the Drift. Kest's cunning and Wren's chart-reading get them aloft just ahead of the pursuit.
scenes.title: The Smuggler's Run

scenes.conflict: Isolde insists the decay is a natural cycle that must not be disturbed and dismisses Wren as a meddler, her doctrine blinding her to the maps.
scenes.goal: Wren seeks the Storm Singers' starlight weaving verses, which are needed to repair the bridges.
scenes.outcome: Isolde refuses to share the songs, but notices that Wren's decay pattern matches the wind-readings in her own songs, planting doubt.
scenes.summary: On the windswept needle peaks, Wren and Kest plead with Isolde. She rejects them, yet her pale eyes linger on the charts.
scenes.title: The Songs Refused

scenes.conflict: The Wanderers are split between cooperating and letting the neglectful old enclaves suffer; Kest's distrust makes him almost sabotage the offer.
scenes.goal: Wren and Kest try to win the Drift Wanderers' support for an alliance of the enclaves.
scenes.outcome: Kest, tested by Wren's honesty and by his loyalty to ordinary islanders, persuades a majority of the Wanderers to join, committing to the cause.
scenes.summary: Back among the broken arches, Wren admits her charts alone will not persuade anyone. Kest rallies his people to join her.
scenes.title: The Wanderers Divided

scenes.conflict: Garrick pressures Tobias to withhold the survey data while Wren demands he publish it; Tobias's caution threatens to delay until it is nearly too late.
scenes.goal: Wren returns to Lantern Reach to win Tobias's public backing as the Guild's maps become the strongest proof available.
scenes.outcome: Shamed by Wren's courage and a further fading strand, Tobias publicly backs her and spends his credibility to summon the enclaves to the central anchor.
scenes.summary: Garrick confronts Tobias in the Guild hall. Wren's resolve finally shames the Guildmaster into speaking publicly and invoking the Accord.
scenes.title: The Guild Under Pressure

scenes.conflict: His pride resists admitting that hoarding the craft hastens the collapse, and his own smiths are dissenting, while Wren's maps predicted exactly this failure.
scenes.goal: Garrick must stop the dimming of an anchor in his own hold, which threatens a skybridge and his people.
scenes.outcome: Garrick chooses survival over pride, concedes the maps were right, and agrees to open the Wardens' craft to a shared weaving at the central anchor.
scenes.summary: As an Ironroot anchor dims just as Wren's chart foretold, Garrick faces his smiths and the evidence. He yields.
scenes.title: The Anchor Dims

scenes.conflict: Isolde must reconcile her doctrine of non-intervention with her wind-readings, which match the maps, and decide whether withholding the songs is faith or fear.
scenes.goal: Wren makes a final appeal for Isolde to teach the starlight weaving verses across enclaves.
scenes.outcome: Isolde redefines her faith as stewardship and agrees to teach the weaving verses at the central anchor.
scenes.summary: Wren shares stories of her lost parents alongside her evidence. Isolde's certainty cracks and she commits to the weaving.
scenes.title: The Songs Shared

scenes.conflict: Old distrust, tribute resentments and a rapidly dimming central anchor threaten to break the effort before dawn, and Wren must hold the factions together.
scenes.goal: All four enclaves jointly re-weave the failing skybridges at night, using Warden-forged anchors and Storm Singer songs guided by Wren's decay maps.
scenes.outcome: The enclaves weave starlight into the central span through the night, restoring the anchor and halting the drift.
scenes.summary: At the central anchor of Lantern Reach, smiths, singers, Wanderers and cartographers work in concert as Wren calls out the order of repair.
scenes.title: The Great Weaving

scenes.conflict: The alliance remains fragile, as grievances over the Hollow Span, the tribute and the Guild's broken neutrality still linger.
scenes.goal: Assess the weaving's success and secure its lasting effects before the alliance fractures again.
scenes.outcome: The Lantern Accord is renewed with Tobias and Kest speaking for the Guild and the Wanderers, and the Hollow Drift is promised repair.
scenes.summary: In the morning light, the bridges hold. Wren and her allies press the leaders to formalise shared upkeep.
scenes.title: Dawn After the Weaving

scenes.conflict: Ending the Edict means admitting his policy hastened the collapse, and risks his smiths' livelihood and his own pride.
scenes.goal: Garrick must decide whether to end the Tribute Edict and share anchor craft permanently.
scenes.outcome: Garrick rescinds the tribute in exchange for recognition of Ironroot's craft within the renewed Accord, and Wren's maps are adopted as a shared reference.
scenes.summary: Garrick meets Wren in the forges and trades the Edict for a fair, shared role in the repair of the bridges.
scenes.title: The Tribute Ended

scenes.conflict: Kest's lingering distrust of authority and the Hollow Span's old wound make him wary of accepting help from the very enclaves that ignored it.
scenes.goal: Begin repairing the Hollow Drift and show the alliance working in practice.
scenes.outcome: Kest accepts the repair as a true ally, Isolde teaches the verses to Wanderer weavers, and Wren, now a bridge between enclaves, begins a new chart of a united archipelago.
scenes.summary: Among the broken arches, singers, smiths and Wanderers start to weave anew, and Wren draws the first lines of a map that joins the islands.
scenes.title: New Charts for a New Sky

logline: When apprentice cartographer Wren Alder's maps reveal that Aerelon's skybridges are failing at an accelerating rate, she must overcome the pride, doctrine and distrust of rival enclaves and unite them to re-weave the bridges before the archipelago drifts apart.
theme: Unity and shared knowledge can mend what pride and secrecy fracture
title: The Skybridge Chronicles
